svg.title: How it works
svg.desc: Four steps. 1 Route: the request is classed as proofreading, revision or humanizing, short or long new writing, or source-based writing. 2 Edit: filler and stock phrasing are cut and sentences restructured while the writer's voice is kept; nothing is padded or invented. 3 Check: every negation, hedge, number, citation, condition and causal claim is compared with the original, and the length is checked, for example 238 of 250 words; an optional script gives exact counts, meaning flags and a copied-phrase check. 4 Deliver: only the writing, plus one plain sentence when something needs the user's attention.
